profile_text.body:
Ambarella Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and trades under the ticker AMBA. Its website describes it as a maker of AI vision processors for edge applications, and says its imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting data from high-resolution video streams.

The site names advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders and autonomous vehicles among the uses it addresses, and says the company is committed to preparing customers for the road ahead. That is the full extent of the product description in the material available.

Company records give its SEC central index key as 0001280263. No lawsuits are listed against it, and no MCP servers are associated with it. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
